solution.title: Vendor Technical Governance & Anti-Lock-In Playbook (Google + Systems Integrators)

products.name: Vendor Technical Governance & Anti-Lock-In Playbook (Google + Systems Integrators) — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable vendor technical governance method — validate assumptions, review designs, apply anti-lock-in criteria, and keep execution vs architectural authority cleanly separated — so partners deliver sustainable solutions. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Keep architectural control while partners do the work

When Google and systems integrators drive execution, the enterprise can quietly lose architectural control and inherit long-term lock-in. This playbook makes you the primary technical counterpart: a repeatable way to validate vendor assumptions, review designs, challenge implementation approaches, and keep a clean separation between vendor execution responsibility and enterprise architectural authority — so partners deliver sustainable solutions without fragmentation or lock-in.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Governance Overview — the operating model between the enterprise architect and external partners (Google, integrators), and where authority sits.
  • Vendor-Design Review Method — how to review and validate vendor proposals against the target architecture, challenge assumptions, and require clean/sustainable patterns.
  • Anti-Lock-In Criteria — the checklist of portability, data-ownership, standards-conformance, and exit criteria every vendor design must meet; RACI separating execution vs architectural authority.
  • 5 supporting scripts — vendor-deliverable inventory discovery, conformance/anti-lock-in validation, a review/finding report, remediation tracking, and a scope helper.
  • Escalation & a Vendor-Governance runbook — how to handle non-conformant designs, plus Testing gates and Best Practices for durable partner relationships.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Vendor execution that aligns to the target architecture — no long-term lock-in, no fragmentation — with architectural control firmly held by the enterprise.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GWVEND-Discovery.ps1 — inventory the vendor design register and cross-check vendor-created objects
    • GWVEND-Remediation.ps1 — record a governance remediation action against a non-conformant design
    • GWVEND-Report.ps1 — review/finding report over the vendor design register
    • GWVEND-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build and preview the design-authority reviewer and pilot groups
    • GWVEND-Validation.ps1 — score designs against the anti-lock-in criteria and check disposition state

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
